notes.title: BRaG: LIMITED OPEN PLAYTEST
notes.content:
Ready to brew up some fun? We're inviting you to playtest the pre-alpha version of Barista: Rise and Grind and share your feedback. Jump in, make some coffee, and help us make the game better. Your input matters!

📌 What's Included:

 ✅ Core game loop – From bean to cup!
 ✅ Character customization – Make your barista your own.
 ✅ Essential recipes & brewing methods – Master the classics.
 ✅ AI customers – Keep ‘em caffeinated and happy!


🔍 What We’re Looking For:
We’re all about smooth gameplay and rich flavor—so tell us how the experience feels! No need to hunt for bugs right now, just share what’s fun and what’s not.

☕ What's Brewing for Future Playtests:

 ✨ Edit mode – Redesign your café vibe.
 ✨ Shop system – Upgrade your setup.
 ✨ More customization options – New styles and gear.
 ✨ Additional machines – Brew like a pro.
 ✨ Enhanced AI interactions – Smarter, thirstier customers.
 ✨ Clean and Maintenance mode – Keep your café spotless.
 ✨ And more...


💬 Join our Discord to share your feedback, chat with us, or connect with the community. We’d love to hear what you think!

notes.title: CLOSED DISCORD PLAYTEST - MVP 0.1
notes.content:
LIVE CLOSED DISCORD PLAYTEST

Hey all! We are at a point in development where we want your feedback for some of the core gameplay of the game. The playtest is available only to those on our  Discord  since we want to keep the feedback close to us. 

We would really appreciate you fill out the survey on our  Discord  as well after testing the game. 

Cheers
